≡ƒô¥ Walkthrough ## SPE-956 ΓÇö Participatory Channel Planning Mirror (SPE-2637) ### Scope and acceptance criteria - Adds the SPE-956 slice-1 read-only planning mirror across five persisted participatory channel maps. - Provides deterministic, label-only views with counts, empty-state semantics, and stable survivor-registry ordering. - Adds `/participatory-channels` and a Front Desk quick link. - Example fixtures are display-only; no evaluator calls or store mutations occur. ### Layers touched - **Projection:** `getSpe956ParticipatoryChannelMirrorView` builds immutable UI-friendly records. - **UI:** New mirror page, route registration, shared copy, and Front Desk navigation. - **Store/persistence:** No persistence schema or mutation changes; existing hydrated `GameState` maps are read. - **Domain:** No `src/domain` changes. ### Determinism and persistence - Entries sort by locale-independent code-unit `id` ordering. - Repeated view generation is byte-stable. - Hydration/transfer round trips preserve records, and explicitly empty maps produce the empty state. - Week-close ticks, evaluator rewrites, migrations, and event-schema changes are out of scope. ### Tests and documentation - Added projection tests for empty/fixture states, counts, labels, ordering, immutability behavior, hydration, byte stability, and quick-link exposure. - Added page tests for empty and populated rendering. - Updated backlog handoff documentation and added the SPE-956 slice-1 planning document. - Marked persistence slice 5 (SPE-2636) shipped; SPE-956 remains in progress/backlog handoff. - Validation included targeted tests, `npm run lint`, and `npm run verify:backlog-handoff`. ## Walkthrough Adds a read-only SPE-956 participatory channel mirror with deterministic projection logic, UI rendering, routing, Front Desk navigation, tests, and updated planning handoff metadata. ### Changes **SPE-956 participatory channel mirror** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |---|---| |**Planning slice and handoff updates**

# Transforming Code Reviews with AI

## Features

**Automated Reviews**: Continuous reviews of the pull requests including incremental commits. 

**Summarization**: Generates high-level summary and a technical walkthrough of the PR changes.┬á

**Line-by-line review**: Provides line-by-line suggestions committable with one click.

**Codebase verification**:  Verifies the impact on the overall codebase and identifies missing changes.

**Insights into your code**:  Ask any questions on your codebase within the pull request 

**Chat about your code** : Chat with the bot around your code.┬áThe more you chat, the smarter it gets.

**Issue Validation**:  Validates the PR against the linked issues and identifies other related issues┬á
